-- test: error non-existent logger --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger com.nonexistent.package DEBUG
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger
-- expect --
com.example.testapp
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} logger com.nonexistent.package RESET
-- expect --
reset to default


-- test: error selector matched no pods --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator -l nonexistent=label health
-- expect:error --
selector "nonexistent=label" matched no pods in namespace
-- expect:stderr --
selector "nonexistent=label" matched no pods in namespace


-- test: error no pods selected --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator health
-- expect:error --
no pods selected: use -p <pod>, -d <deployment>, or -l <label-selector>
-- expect:error --
e.g. 'kubectl actuator -d my-app health'
-- expect:stderr --
no pods selected


-- test: pod errors go to stderr not stdout --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod nonexistent-pod-12345 health
-- expect:error --
Error:
-- expect:stderr --
Error:
-- expect:not:stdout --
Error:


-- test: partial failure keeps healthy pod output on stdout --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod[0]}} --pod nonexistent-pod-12345 health
-- expect:error --
failed on 1 of 2 pods: nonexistent-pod-12345
-- expect:stdout --
[overall]
-- expect:stderr --
Error (nonexistent-pod-12345):
-- expect:stderr --
not found in namespace
-- expect:not:stdout --
Error:


-- test: invalid output format is rejected --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} health -o bogus
-- expect:error --
invalid output format "bogus", must be one of: wide, json, yaml
